The FE Workflow

From job post to job done —
here's exactly how it works

FE is a marketplace, not a dispatch system. You always choose who works for you.

{# Step 01 Section #}
Step 01

Post your job with full context

Fill out a structured booking form: job title, service category, site address, access timing, scope of work, and your budget range. Upload floor plans, diagrams, photos, and work instructions.

  • ✓ Set a minimum and maximum budget range
  • ✓ Specify exact site access details and security requirements
  • ✓ Upload relevant documents for engineers to review
  • ✓ Define number of engineers, rack count, device count, and scope

Step 02

Nearby engineers see your lead

Once posted, engineers within range get notified immediately. They review your scope, attachments, and budget — and decide whether to apply. No auto-assignment, ever.

  • ✓ Only engineers near your site receive the lead
  • ✓ Engineers see full job details before applying
  • ✓ Multiple engineers can apply — you get options
  • ✓ System never assigns anyone automatically
{# Step 03 #}
Step 03

You pick the engineer you trust

Review every applicant's profile — ratings, completed jobs, skills, and certifications. Select the engineer (or engineers) you feel most confident about. The job is awarded only when you approve.

  • ✓ See full profiles with ratings and job history
  • ✓ Hire one or multiple engineers for a single job
  • ✓ You're always in control — no system decides for you
  • ✓ Rejected applicants are notified automatically

Step 04

Track progress. Pay when done.

Once the engineer is on-site, you track real-time progress. Engineers upload proof of completion. You verify and release payment — securely held in escrow until work is approved.

  • ✓ Real-time job progress updates from the engineer
  • ✓ Photo and document uploads as proof of completion
  • ✓ Payment released only after your approval
  • ✓ Leave a rating to help the community
